caveat.zh: 关键词后端（字符二元组 + IDF），不需要任何服务；默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.25、比例 0.70），分数线在开发集上选定。
caveat.en: Keyword backend (character bigrams + IDF), no services needed; default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.25, ratio 0.70), lines chosen on the dev set.

caveat.zh: 向量后端（bge-m3，暴力余弦），默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.30、比例 0.60）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Vector backend (bge-m3, brute-force cosine), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.30, ratio 0.60); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 关键词 + 向量，概率“或”融合，默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.40、比例 0.65）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Keyword + vector with probabilistic-OR fusion, default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.40, ratio 0.65); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 向量后端换成较轻的模型 bge-small-zh-v1.5（F16，47.9 MB，512 维，只支持中文），该模型的预设（floor、ceil、分数线、前缀），默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.10、比例 0.65）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Vector backend with the lighter model bge-small-zh-v1.5 (F16, 47.9 MB, 512 dims, Chinese only), that model's preset (floor, ceil, score lines, prefixes), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.10, ratio 0.65); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 向量后端换成较轻的模型 bge-base-zh-v1.5（Q8_0，110 MB，768 维，只支持中文），该模型的预设（floor、ceil、分数线、前缀），默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.05、比例 0.50）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Vector backend with the lighter model bge-base-zh-v1.5 (Q8_0, 110 MB, 768 dims, Chinese only), that model's preset (floor, ceil, score lines, prefixes), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.05, ratio 0.50); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 向量后端换成较轻的模型 embeddinggemma（622 MB，768 维，多语言），该模型的预设（floor、ceil、分数线、前缀），默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.30、比例 0.60）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Vector backend with the lighter model embeddinggemma (622 MB, 768 dims, multilingual), that model's preset (floor, ceil, score lines, prefixes), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.30, ratio 0.60); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 向量后端换成较轻的模型 qwen3-embedding 0.6B（639 MB，1024 维，多语言），该模型的预设（floor、ceil、分数线、前缀），默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.15、比例 0.65）；需要一个 embeddings 接口。
caveat.en: Vector backend with the lighter model qwen3-embedding 0.6B (639 MB, 1024 dims, multilingual), that model's preset (floor, ceil, score lines, prefixes), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.15, ratio 0.65); needs an embeddings endpoint.

caveat.zh: 混合后端 + 默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.40、比例 0.65）+ freshness（遗忘账本，默认设置，不做清理）；记忆带自己的日期。
caveat.en: Hybrid backend + default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.40, ratio 0.65) + freshness (forgetting ledger, default settings, no sweep); memories carry their own dates.

caveat.zh: 网关接在 OpenViking（只读存储）前面，默认召回步骤（宽松档 broad：min_score 0.55、比例 0.90）。
caveat.en: The gateway in front of OpenViking (read-only store), default recall stages (broad profile: min_score 0.55, ratio 0.90).

caveat.zh: add(infer=False) 逐字入库，不用 LLM；默认检索 top_k=20、阈值 0.1，实际交付 20 条。其 BM25 和实体部分依赖英文模型，对中文不起作用，排名基本是 bge-m3 余弦。
caveat.en: add(infer=False), verbatim, no LLM; default search top_k=20, threshold 0.1, so 20 items are delivered. Its BM25 and entity parts rely on English-only models and contribute nothing on Chinese: the ranking is effectively bge-m3 cosine.

caveat.zh: add(infer=True)，由 LLM 提取事实后入库（约 206 万 tokens）；检索默认值同逐字版，实际交付约 20 条。
caveat.en: add(infer=True): an LLM extracts facts before storing (about 2.06 M tokens); same search defaults as the verbatim run, about 20 items delivered.

caveat.zh: Markdown 入库，稠密 + BM25 的 RRF 融合；没有阈值和字数预算，交付 = 前 5 条；插件本身不自动注入，是否检索由模型决定。
caveat.en: Markdown ingest, dense + BM25 fused by RRF; no threshold or character budget, delivered = top 5; the plugin does not inject automatically, the model decides whether to search.

caveat.zh: 直接写记忆文件，不走会话提取（真实部署会用模型提取，这里没测）；API 默认值，没有阈值，交付约 10 条；默认插件设置未能核实。
caveat.en: Memory files written directly, no session extraction (a real deployment extracts with a model; not measured); API defaults, no threshold, about 10 items delivered; the plugin's own defaults could not be verified.

caveat.zh: 实验变体：和 openviking 同样的调用，目录摘要保留为无编号条目（全部排名里只有 8 条），两行几乎一样。
caveat.en: Experiment variant: same calls as openviking, directory summaries kept as id-less items (only 8 in all ranked lists), so the two rows are nearly identical.

caveat.zh: 默认后端 Mnemon Native（SQLite，关键词 + 实体 + 图信号打分，无向量）；每次运行结果约 ±5 个百分点波动；默认写入走 LLM 复盘，这里绕过了（逐字写入），没有测；记忆日期不进存储；插件不自动注入，由模型调用召回。
caveat.en: Default Mnemon Native backend (SQLite; keyword, entity and graph signals, no vectors); results move about ±5 points run to run; the default write path is an LLM review which was bypassed (verbatim writes) and is not measured; memory dates are not stored; the plugin does not inject automatically, the model calls recall.

caveat.zh: 同 dsh-mnemon，打开了可选的向量模式（bge-m3）；每次运行约 ±5 个百分点波动；LLM 复盘被绕过。
caveat.en: As dsh-mnemon with the optional embedding mode switched on (bge-m3); about ±5 points run to run; the LLM review is bypassed.

caveat.zh: 按设计每轮自动注入的是会话里最新的 4 条，不看问题，所以“交付命中”为 0 是设计使然，不是检索失败；排名用的是它的 BM25 读取。
caveat.en: By design the per-turn injection is the 4 newest items of the session and ignores the question, so a deployed hit of 0 follows from the design, not from failed retrieval; the ranking uses its BM25 read.

caveat.zh: BM25 关键词检索；关键词由插件自带分词器生成（真实使用由 LLM 写关键词）；每条消息只按关键词命中注入前 2 条。
caveat.en: BM25 keyword retrieval; keywords come from the plugin's own tokenizer (in real use an LLM writes them); the per-message injection takes the top 2 keyword hits.

caveat.zh: 非推荐的技术栈：嵌入式 Kuzu（上游已标记弃用）+ 一个小 LLM（deepseek-flash）做提取，中文单句记忆；总共约 118 万 tokens；返回的是提取出的事实边，不是原文。
caveat.en: Non-recommended stack: embedded Kuzu (deprecated upstream) + a small LLM (deepseek-flash) for extraction, on one-sentence Chinese memories; about 1.18 M tokens; it returns extracted fact edges, not the original text.

caveat.zh: 插件自己的 remember 工具逐字写入；每轮自动注入走它的 recall()：查询门、词稀有度证据分、阈值 0.30、最多 6 条、800 字预算。后台关键词扩展需要模型，这里没有模型，被跳过；平均只交付约 2 条，约三分之一的问题因查询门或没有命中词而安静。
caveat.en: Verbatim writes through the plugin's own remember tool; the per-turn injection runs its recall(): query gate, word-rarity evidence score, threshold 0.30, at most 6 items, 800-character budget. The background keyword expansion needs a model and is skipped here; about 2 items are delivered on average, and about a third of the questions stay quiet because of the query gate or no matching word.

caveat.zh: 同 dsh-fish-memory，插件自己的后台关键词扩展用 deepseek-flash 运行（关闭思考；121 次调用，约 6.2 万输入 / 0.3 万输出 tokens，来自 API 用量）；写入仍是逐字，模型只补检索词，不改写记忆。
caveat.en: As dsh-fish-memory, with the plugin's own background keyword expansion run by deepseek-flash (thinking disabled; 121 calls, about 62 k input / 3 k output tokens, from the API usage); writes stay verbatim, the model only adds retrieval words and does not rewrite memories.

caveat.zh: 同 dsh-fish-memory，后台关键词扩展用 claude-haiku-5-5 运行（显式关闭思考，不发送 temperature）；写入仍是逐字。
caveat.en: As dsh-fish-memory, with the background keyword expansion run by claude-haiku-5-5 (thinking explicitly disabled, no temperature sent); writes stay verbatim.

caveat.zh: memory_add 直接写入 L1（产品里由模型从对话蒸馏，这里没测）；默认召回：FTS5 BM25 + jieba/二元分词，阈值 0.3，最多 5 条，新鲜度加权，字数预算 2000；向量关闭。
caveat.en: memory_add writes L1 directly (the product distils conversation with a model; not measured); default recall: FTS5 BM25 over jieba and bigram tokens, threshold 0.3, at most 5 items, freshness weighting, 2000-character budget; embeddings off.

caveat.zh: 同 dsh-prime-memory，打开了插件可选的远程向量模式（bge-m3），关键词和向量结果融合；仍是直接写入。
caveat.en: As dsh-prime-memory with the plugin's optional remote-embedding mode switched on (bge-m3), keyword and vector results fused; still written directly.

caveat.zh: 只测记忆部分（人设卡不是记忆）；每条记忆写成一个 topic 文件；检索按词和汉字二元组命中 key / 标题 / 摘要 / 正文打分，没有分数阈值，只要共享一个词就是候选；默认 5 个 topic、1600 字。
caveat.en: Only the memory half is measured (persona cards are not memory); each memory is written as one topic file; search scores word and Han-bigram hits in key / title / summary / body, with no score threshold, so a shared term makes a candidate; defaults 5 topics, 1600 characters.

caveat.zh: Hindsight 服务端的无模型模式：每条记忆逐字存为一个 chunk，不做事实提取，不做 consolidation；召回用服务端默认的四路（语义、关键词、图、时间）融合 + 本地重排序，嵌入换成 bge-m3；只受 2000 token 预算限制，平均交付约 94 条。插件默认的 reflect 注入是模型写的文字，不是记忆列表，没有测。
caveat.en: Hindsight's server in its mode without a model: each memory stored verbatim as one chunk, no fact extraction, no consolidation; recall is the server's default four arms (semantic, keyword, graph, temporal) fused and reranked by its local cross-encoder, with bge-m3 embeddings; limited only by the 2000-token budget, about 94 items delivered on average. The plugin's default reflect injection is a model-written text, not a list of memories, and is not measured.

caveat.zh: Hindsight 服务端的默认工作方式：模型逐条提取事实并 consolidation 成 observation（模型 deepseek-flash，关闭思考），召回为 observation 类型，其余同 hindsight-chunks。插件默认的 reflect 注入是模型写的文字，不是记忆列表，没有测。
caveat.en: Hindsight's server as it works by default: a model (deepseek-flash, thinking disabled) extracts facts from each memory and consolidates them into observations; recall returns observations, the rest as hindsight-chunks. The plugin's default reflect injection is a model-written text, not a list of memories, and is not measured.

caveat.zh: Hindsight 服务端的默认工作方式：模型逐条提取事实并 consolidation 成 observation（模型 claude-haiku-5-5，关闭思考），召回为 observation 类型，其余同 hindsight-chunks。插件默认的 reflect 注入是模型写的文字，不是记忆列表，没有测。
caveat.en: Hindsight's server as it works by default: a model (claude-haiku-5-5, thinking disabled) extracts facts from each memory and consolidates them into observations; recall returns observations, the rest as hindsight-chunks. The plugin's default reflect injection is a model-written text, not a list of memories, and is not measured.

caveat.zh: BM25 + 图激活，没有向量检索；用真实容器日期，新鲜度项对所有记忆接近 0。
caveat.en: BM25 + graph activation, no vector search; real container date, so the freshness term is about 0 for every memory.

caveat.zh: 实验变体：时钟拨快 365 天后跑一次衰减；没有一条被标记为遗忘（fact 级记忆不会被遗忘）。
caveat.en: Experiment variant: clock moved 365 days ahead, then a decay sweep; no memory was marked forgotten (level fact is never forgotten).

caveat.zh: 365 天老化实验，不是默认运行：记忆按 detail 级写入，老化后 240 条全部被标记为遗忘，什么都召回不到（Hit@5 0%，安静率 100%）。
caveat.en: A 365-day ageing experiment, not a default run: memories written at detail level, all 240 are marked forgotten after ageing, so nothing is recalled (Hit@5 0%, quiet rate 100%).

caveat.zh: 和 feiyu-memgate-sqlite 完全一样，只是固定 [recall] profile = "precise"：min_score 0.30、比例 0.75（默认的宽松档是 0.25 / 0.70）。留出集上，默认档 → 精确档：交付命中 46.7% → 39.2%，精确率 89.3% → 93.0%，安静率 70.0% → 75.0%，每题交付 0.55 → 0.41 条；交得少而准，对没有答案的问题更常保持安静，漏答更多。
caveat.en: Identical to feiyu-memgate-sqlite except [recall] profile = "precise" is pinned: min_score 0.30, ratio 0.75 (the default broad profile uses 0.25 / 0.70). On the held-out set, default -> precise: delivered hit 46.7% -> 39.2%, precision 89.3% -> 93.0%, quiet rate 70.0% -> 75.0%, items per question 0.55 -> 0.41; it delivers less and more precisely, stays quiet more often when there is no answer, and misses more questions.
